title: Systems of Equations: Graphing, Substitution, Elimination | Algebra I, Unit 6
description:
Solve systems of linear equations by graphing, substitution and elimination, recognize systems with no solution or infinitely many, solve word problems with two unknowns, and graph systems of linear inequalities. Each section ends with a practice problem.
